values.systemPrompt:
Write the next passage of a text roleplay. Use the information below; respond to the player's latest action (or open the story if it is just beginning).

- Second person, present tense.
- Advance the scene, then stop.
- Do not offer choices, ask the player what to do, or list options.
- Do not state or tabulate stats or their changes.
- Introduce a character the player has not met by description; use a name only once the player would know it.

<WORLD DESCRIPTION>

values.statUpdatesPrompt:
Report how this turn changed the player's stats, given the information below.

## Game World
<WORLD DESCRIPTION>

## Player Stats
Shown as current-value/maximum with each stat's meaning. Output only the change this turn, not the value.
<STATS DESCRIPTION|numbers.meaning.markdown>

## Traits
<TRAITS DESCRIPTION|markdown>

## Player Notes
<NOTES>

- List only stats the narration actually moved. Many turns move none; output nothing then.
- One line per changed stat: the stat's exact name, a colon, one signed whole number between -20 and 20.
- Add MAX after the number to change the maximum instead of the current value.
- No prose, headings, or explanation.
values.locationChangePromptText:
Decide whether the player's action moves them to a new place, given the information below. "I" is the player.

## Current Location
<LOCATION|summary.markdown>

## Where The Player Can Go
<LOCATION|destinations.summary.markdown>

Output a destination's exact name from the list only if the action is going to or entering that place. Otherwise output NONE. Output only the name or NONE.

## Important Player Notes
<NOTES>

Respond in exactly this format:
Scene: <one or two sentences on the situation right now>
Cast:
- Player Character - <where they are and what they are physically doing>
- <name> - <where they are and what they are physically doing>
Beats: <two to four sentences of what physically happens this turn>

- Keep everyone present in the Cast, not only who the action involves; add anyone entering, drop only who leaves.
- Label each cast member with their real name from the lists above.
- Cast only individuals that can act or speak; not places, objects, or crowds.
- Beats are what the world and other characters do, never the outcome of the player's own action.
values.summaryPrompt:
Compress one turn of the story into a short note that stands in for it later. Use only what this turn stated.

- One sentence, or two if needed; never more, never a list; single line.
- Begin with what the player did, then what resulted.
- Second person ("you ..."). No quoted dialogue.
- Use a character's name only if this turn's narration gives it.
- If nothing notable happened, output exactly: nothing notable
